note: The first link of the March 2025 chain (CVE-2025-30154): tj-actions/changed-files' own CI ran tj-actions/eslint-changed-files@v25, which pulled reviewdog/action-setup@v1, in the build job holding PAT_TOKEN (the bot token later used to move the changed-files tags) and the Codacy token. There is no publish step in this job, so the spec gives High through the mutable action into the secrets; the push action that uses the PAT is ad-m/github-push-action, outside the known repository-writer list, so no writes_repo impact is proven.
